Lakeside Book Exchange
Your old books can open up a whole new world for a local student. Think about how exciting it is for a child to read a story for the first time. You can be part of that moment by taking the books off your shelves and giving them to us, so we can pass them on to young readers who need them. Call us at 555-0184 to arrange a collection. On the day we agree on, simply pack your books in a sturdy box and leave it by your front door, and one of our volunteers will collect it. Every book counts, and your kindness is greatly appreciated!
sets.tr:
Lakeside Book Exchange

Greenfield Winter Coat Drive
A warm coat can make all the difference to a neighbor in need this winter. Picture the relief a family feels when every child has something warm to wear on the walk to school. You can make that possible by pulling that unused coat out of your closet and passing it along to us, so we can deliver it to someone who needs it. Call us at 555-0137 to set up a pickup. Before the scheduled day, please make sure each coat has been washed, then hang it in a bag on your front doorknob, and our driver will take care of the rest. Your support keeps our community warm!

Thank you for choosing the Ardent PX2 label printer! Getting started takes only a few minutes.
Before printing for the first time, insert the ink cartridge into the slot at the back of the printer. When the light on the front panel stops blinking, the cartridge is ready. To turn the PX2 on, press the round button on the left side of the printer, just below the paper tray.
When the printer starts, you will be asked to select a display language. To print a label, type your text and press the "print" key. The paper width can be set using the dial on the right side of the printer. Print darkness can be increased or decreased using the plus and minus buttons on the top panel.
sets.tr:
Ardent PX2 라벨 프린터를 선택해 주셔서 감사합니다! 시작하는 데 몇 분이면 됩니다.
처음 인쇄하기 전에 프린터 뒷면 슬롯에 잉크 카트리지를 끼우세요. 전면 패널의 표시등이 깜박임을 멈추면 카트리지가 준비된 것입니다. PX2를 켜려면 용지함 바로 아래, 프린터 왼쪽의 둥근 버튼을 누르세요.
프린터가 켜지면 화면 언어를 선택하라는 안내가 나옵니다. 라벨을 인쇄하려면 문구를 입력하고 '인쇄' 키를 누르세요. 용지 폭은 프린터 오른쪽의 다이얼로 설정할 수 있습니다. 인쇄 농도는 상단 패널의 플러스·마이너스 버튼으로 높이거나 낮출 수 있습니다.

Ana Park (2:05 P.M.) I just read that Daniel Ruiz is opening a hotel downtown next spring! You know, the man who owns those two Italian restaurants on Bay Street.
Ben Ortiz (2:09 P.M.) Really? I had no idea he was interested in the hotel business!
Ana Park (2:11 P.M.) Me neither. I guess he wants to bring his style of hospitality to visitors from out of town.
Ben Ortiz (2:12 P.M.) Do you think he'll ask us to provide the flowers for the hotel lobby? He has been ordering table arrangements from us for years.
Ana Park (2:14 P.M.) I hope so!
sets.tr:

Ben Ortiz (오후 2:09) 정말요? 그분이 호텔 사업에 관심 있는 줄 전혀 몰랐어요!
Ana Park (오후 2:11) 저도요. 외지 방문객들에게 자기만의 접객 방식을 보여 주고 싶은가 봐요.
Ben Ortiz (오후 2:12) 그분이 호텔 로비 꽃을 저희에게 맡길까요? 몇 년째 저희한테 테이블 장식 꽃을 주문해 오셨잖아요.
Ana Park (오후 2:14) 그러면 좋겠어요!
